title: Anholt Castle
scope: The standing northern Hauptburg of Wasserburg Anholt, with four joined courtyard ranges, the east projection and the Dicke Turm.
limitations: Only the northern Hauptburg is represented. The neighboring Vorburg, moat bridges, park and historic rooms remain outside this asset.
